svg.desc: All 16 group-stage and Round-of-32 stadiums in the USA, Canada and Mexico. Guadalajara and Philadelphia hosted the group stage only; the other 14 hosted both. Each city name is centered above its stadium dot. Alaska, Hawaii and the Western Aleutians are excluded.
